name: streetlight-snow-embrace-portrait
image_purpose: Winter lifestyle and social profile content

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic joyful winter-night portrait under a glowing streetlamp.
prompt.main_subject: The same approved adult person as the required face reference, standing outdoors with arms outstretched and enjoying softly falling snow. Preserve natural micro-expressions and face structure. The subject wears a long textured teddy-style coat, thick scarf and casual jeans.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-body portrait with the subject centered under the streetlamp halo, arms open, snow-covered ground and distant trees behind. Include warm lamplight in the foreground, atmospheric haze and a darker cool background for depth.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden streetlamp illumination scattering through snowflakes with realistic shimmer and soft lens bloom, warm-to-cool contrast, natural shadow placement, lively immersive winter mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical winter portrait, full-frame camera with 50mm lens, realistic snow particles, textile texture and hair movement, optical depth, subtle grain, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the same approved adult face from the attached image without altering facial features. Create an ultra-photorealistic nighttime winter scene featuring the character standing outdoors with arms outstretched and enjoying softly falling snow under a glowing streetlamp. Capture the warm cinematic illumination created by the lamp's halo, golden light scattering through snowflakes with realistic particle shimmer and soft lens bloom. The character wears a long textured teddy-style coat, thick scarf and casual jeans, all rendered with realistic fabric behavior. Snow-covered ground and distant trees receive ambient light, creating natural depth and atmospheric haze. Hair interacts naturally with wind and light, with warm-to-cool contrast between the lamplit foreground and darker background. The scene feels lively, immersive and joyful with high-resolution realism, natural skin texture and no logos or watermark.
